"""Paths for the files named by A104's retained implementation receipts."""

from pathlib import Path


def source_file(name):
    if Path(name).name != name and name not in LITERATURE_BINDING_SOURCES:
        raise ValueError('literature_implementation_basename_required')
    local = Path(__file__).parent / name
    if local.is_file():
        return local
    raise FileNotFoundError(name)
